snippet.title: Mario Forever: Party Worlds Reimagined - Release Trailer (Source Included!)
snippet.description:
Yes. It's finally here.
Party Worlds Reimagined is the remake of my original world series "Party Worlds" not only ported to Thunder Engine, but also expanded! Featuring 2 new worlds!

And that's not it!
As the title says, I will be including the entire source project alongside the game!

DOWNLOAD:
https://marioforever.space/topic/54/mario-forever-party-worlds-reimagined-source-included

Thank you for believing.
- looper ^ Meteo Dream
